description: HW7 Part 2/3 fixed verification cases. Each needs at least two tool calls with no follow-up prompt.

tasks.prompt: Search for frozen spinach recall notices, then look up the full details of the first search result. Tell me its notice code, manufacturer and description.

Answer this in two tool steps. Step 1: call recall_stats with group_by "category" to find which recall category has the most notices. Step 2: call search_notices with query "peanut butter" and category set to the top category from step 1. Then give the top category and one example notice code from the step 2 search results.

Search for peanut butter recall notices, then get the full details of the first two results. Compare just those two notices: which one affected more units, and who are their manufacturers? Cite both notice codes.

error_case.prompt: Give me the full details of recall notice RCL-2026-99999.
